title: Character Design
description: Locked recurring-character references produced by the story pipeline's conditional character_design stage. Each recurring character has a flux2 t2i reference image + style anchors that scene_plan references and assets enforces via faceswap.

style_playbook.description: Name of the active style playbook

characters.description: One entry per recurring character. Empty array is valid (the stage ran but found no recurring characters).

id.description: Stable character id referenced by scene_plan/asset_manifest

reference_image.description: Path to the locked flux2 t2i reference image used for per-scene faceswap

key_features.description: Distinguishing features that must hold across scenes

emotions.description: Emotional range the character must express

prompt_seed.description: The base prompt used to generate the reference image (provenance + reuse)
